name: Portrait of a Seated Civil Official
dimensions:
painting proper: H. 155.3 x W. 95.8 cm (61 1/8 x 37 11/16 in.)
mounting: H. 302.3 x W. 116.8 cm (119 x 46 in.)
summary: This hanging scroll depicts a seated gentleman dressed in the red robe of an official; emblazoned with two crested birds in flight amidst clouds, the so-called mandarin square, or badge of rank, indicates that he is a civil official. He sits in a magistrate's chair draped with silk brocade. Visible at the bottom, the lacquer chair shows scrolling designs carved through alternating layers of red and black lacquer.
